cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments to cover! Put 'cross-department lead' on my schedule, please. We should record the expanded remit accurately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. A rotating departmental presence, not borrowed space. List each room under my remit, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Label it with all three departments, please. Full names, on both sides, so they know when headquarters has arrived.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 remit recording, A3 rotating-presence correction and A5 trolley labels make professional classification celebrate burdens as expanded jurisdiction.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 no budget and B4 lost desk remain actual restrictions; A calls them reach without narrator endorsement.

relationship.evidence: B2 resource constraint and B4 trolley solution each materially change A positive interpretation.

heightening.evidence: B4 trolley causes A5 mobile headquarters with department labels on both sides.

specificity.evidence: A1 three departments and B4 receptionist taking desk establish concrete workload and space loss.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 names and label placement give B specific action serving A wish to be recognised across departments.
